name: X-Men Expanded Reading Order: Silver Age to Claremont
description: The expanded Silver Age-to-Claremont route adds the two sections the outline marked optional to the core reading order. Compiled by hand from the same reader's outline of Comic Book Herald's guides. The Silver Age add-ons are the guest appearances that carried the X-Men through the years their own title was running reprints, scattered across Amazing Adventures, Spider-Man, the Hulk, the Avengers, Captain America, the Defenders and Giant-Size Fantastic Four. The modern retellings revisit the same years from the outside: The Hidden Years, Grand Design, Season One and the whole of First Class. X-Men Annual #1 and #2 are listed without a link, because Marvel's metadata carries that series only from #3.
